title: The Whispering Pages
description: A young librarian discovers a magical book that rewrites itself based on the reader’s emotions, leading her into a hidden world threatened by ancient forces.
author: Liana Greywood

title: Circuits of Tomorrow
description: In a future run by sentient AI, a rogue engineer uncovers a buried truth that could restore free will to humanity—if he survives long enough.
author: Dr. Alan Mercer

title: Beneath the Monsoon Sky
description: Set in coastal India, this story follows three siblings who reunite after years apart and confront the emotional storms shaping their lives.
author: Kavya Raman

title: The Last Equation
description: A brilliant mathematician is forced into a deadly conspiracy when she cracks an unsolvable code linked to global cyber-attacks.
author: Marcus Hale

title: Maplewood Café Stories
description: A cozy collection of short tales capturing the lives and secrets of the regulars at a small-town café.
author: Helen Jacobs

title: The Quantum Gardeners
description: In a world where plants are genetically engineered to reshape ecosystems, a rebellious botanist uncovers a government plot to weaponize them.
author: Naomi Isler
